title: A new work order for a split customer starts with Labor and Parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B.
  • Open the Work Orders page in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Create a new work order for the customer.
  2. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" sales rep B.

Step 2:

  • One "Sales Representative" field shows, reading sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R25: “A new work order for a split customer starts with the Labor and Parts fields: "Sales Representative - Labor" holds the customer's Service Labor person and "Sales Representative - Parts" holds the customer's Service Parts person. Removing its Parts field works as S2-R16.”
  • S2-R16: “Clicking the remove x replaces the two fields with the one "Sales Representative" field. It holds the person who was in "Sales Representative - Labor", or "Unassigned", and that person is credited with the whole work order, labor and parts.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
